notes: Full continuous paved course independently digitized from97 manual native-image centre controls. The prior OSM selection is displaced from the visible pavement. The prior source-guided mask-fit diagnostic is not used to construct these source pixels. Source geometry, configuration, direction and georeferencing remain draft estimates; no operator dimensions, diagram coordinates or nominal road width are fitted. No timing coordinate is available. Raw licensed imagery is not redistributed; the trace retains its source-specific licence.

The independently image-mapped loop is approximately 1.197 km in the source trace and 1.192 km in the driving model. The operator lists a nominal 1.280 km course. This image-derived candidate has not been verified as that official configuration; no scale or distance fit is applied.

source.name: Mapzen Terrain Tiles
attribution: Global elevation data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey and NOAA.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 24 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

measurement.note: Complete sparse road limits estimated from20 native-image cross-sections plus exact closure, on the independently digitized image-source route. Positions read in native and rectified crops; faded paint, pit/apron joins, blue runoff and imagery blur limit reading to roughly1-2m, not surveyed accuracy. Main dark-pavement limits exclude blue runoff where distinguishable; joins near the western return and inner S remain interpolated estimates. Intermediate offsets follow the corrected source normals and are not independent edge observations. No operator nominal width or lap length is fitted. Original OSM trace remains in research evidence; original missing timing remains missing. Curbs illustrative, terrain estimated and banking unknown.

borderInference.note: Road-border estimates reconstructed directly from complete, sparse image measurements on the existing trace cross-sections. All intervals interpolate between image anchors; they are not automatic detections or a continuous edge survey. Every saved edge station and anchor requires pinned-image coverage during authoring. Isolated missing pixels inside the road are not filled or used as boundary evidence. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy. These borders have not been formally verified.
